title: 数智风控：面向新产品的信用风险评估 (Data Science Contest - Credit Risk Assessment)
summary: A data science competition project predicting credit default risk from a small, highly imbalanced credit-risk dataset, combining a baseline ensemble/stacking pipeline with an experimental GAN-based data-augmentation method. The GANmodel component trains sdv.single_table.CTGANSynthesizer (with a SingleTableMetadata object) to generate synthetic minority-class default samples for augmenting the training set.
